notes.title: Update Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
This update adds a new feature - [b]two new difficulty modes![/b]

[b]Story Difficulty:[/b]
[list]
[*] -player health is doubled
[*] -some enemy attack patterns made easier
[/list]

[b]Lunatic Difficulty:[/b]
[list]
[*] -enemy health is doubled
[*] -some save points are removed and replaced with recovery hearts
[/list]

In addition to these new modes, some other minor changes and bugfixes have been implemented:

[list]
[*] -reduced filesize from 7GB to 2GB
[*] -fixed bug with playtime not updating properly
[*] -added achievement page to main menu
[*] -fixed item description text not displaying properly on steam deck
[*] -Added item completion % to map screen
[*] -added red edges on screen when at 1hp
[*] -fixed bug with player bullets disappearing when fired too close to a wall
[*] -added an additional save point midway through the Gate of Truth section
[*] -minor visual updates
[/list]
